locator: April 11, 1938 Wright Field notes, NLM v. 6 image 29
note: The archival note identifies the same chamber and named individual as the Fulton chapter, with collapse and brief paralysis a few days before April 11. The note estimates about 30,000 ft and considers aeroembolism possible to probable. The journal report gives 35,000 ft as the reported ascent target. Exact onset altitude and calendar date remain unresolved.
